name: Riola
source:
At first glance an expressionless and taciturn girl, she's really very chatty.

She respects Edgar as "a great senior adventurer". She has a habit of saying "I see, that's good to know" and taking notes immediately after she starts conversations with veteran adventurers.

She used to live a quiet life together with nature in a forest far from human habitation, but she was entranced by the story of an adventurer told to her by a human who blundered into her forest and left her forest with a yearning for the world beyond.

[Spoiler] Naive to the ways of the world, Riola blunders into Dantor shortly after leaving her forest and is taken in by Edgar just after his assumption as Guild Master. She is easily misled, even going so far as to believe servicing Edgar would ensure her job security. 

Despite her naivete and inexperience, her powers as a Brightleaf Shaman are not to be trifled with and she aims to become just as famous as other Brightleaf shamans and spell-users from the distant past.

When she successfully rescues the children from the ensorcelled tome, her reputation in the guild and Dantor's community increases. Regardless, her humility and drive to improve herself impresses Edgar. [/Spoiler]
